brief:
France's President Emmanuel Macron dismissed US President Donald Trump's assertions of achieving peace in Gaza, stating that no humanitarian corridors have reopened in the enclave despite Trump's assertions, according to Al-Monitor reporting on remarks made at the United Nations on Tuesday. Macron characterized the diplomatic efforts as a "spectacle of shame," suggesting the claimed breakthrough lacked substantive results on the ground.

The French leader's comments reflect deepening disagreement between Paris and Washington over Gaza strategy and the credibility of ceasefire claims. Macron's criticism targeted both the validity of Trump's diplomatic claims and the humanitarian consequences of inaction in the territory.

title: Macron denounces Trump's Gaza peace claims as false spectacle
